title: Gideon's Call

questions.question: Who oppressed Israel for seven years?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:1 (ESV): "...and the LORD gave them into the hand of Midian seven years."

questions.question: Where was Gideon beating out wheat?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:11 (ESV): "...Gideon was beating out wheat in the winepress to hide it from the Midianites."

questions.question: What did the angel call Gideon?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:12 (ESV): "...The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor."

questions.question: What was the sign of the fleece (first night)?
options: Dew on the fleece only, ground dry
Dew on ground only, fleece dry
questions.correctAnswer: Dew on the fleece only, ground dry
questions.explanation: Judges 6:37 (ESV): "...If there is dew on the fleece alone, and it is dry on all the ground..."

questions.question: What name was Gideon given after destroying the altar of Baal?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:32 (ESV): "Therefore on that day he was called Jerubbaal..."

questions.question: What did the Midianites leave for Israel to eat?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:4 (ESV): "...and left no sustenance in Israel and no sheep or ox or donkey."

questions.question: Who did the Israelites cry out to?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:6 (ESV): "...and the people of Israel cried out to the LORD."

questions.question: What did Gideon bring to the angel as an offering?
options: A young goat and unleavened cakes
questions.correctAnswer: A young goat and unleavened cakes
questions.explanation: Judges 6:19 (ESV): "So Gideon went into his house and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes..."

questions.question: What happened when the angel touched the offering with his staff?
options: Fire sprang up from the rock and consumed it
questions.correctAnswer: Fire sprang up from the rock and consumed it
questions.explanation: Judges 6:21 (ESV): "...And fire sprang up from the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes..."

questions.question: How many bulls was Gideon told to take?
options: Two (one young bull and a second seven-year-old bull)
questions.correctAnswer: Two (one young bull and a second seven-year-old bull)
questions.explanation: Judges 6:25 (ESV): "...Take your father's bull, and the second bull seven years old..."

questions.question: Why did Gideon ask for a sign?
options: To know that it was God speaking to him
Because he didn't want to go
questions.correctAnswer: To know that it was God speaking to him
questions.explanation: Judges 6:17 (ESV): "...then show me a sign that it is you who speak with me."

questions.question: What does Jerubbaal mean?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:32 (ESV): "...saying, 'Let Baal contend against him,' because he broke down his altar."

questions.question: Who was Gideon the son of?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:11 (ESV): "...which belonged to Joash the Abiezrite..."

questions.question: When did Gideon destroy the altar of Baal?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:27 (ESV): "...he did it by night and not by day."

questions.question: What happened to the Spirit of the Lord?
options: It clothed Gideon / rushed upon him
questions.correctAnswer: It clothed Gideon / rushed upon him
questions.explanation: Judges 6:34 (ESV): "But the Spirit of the LORD clothed Gideon..."

key_verse_text: And the angel of the LORD appeared to him and said to him, “The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.” (ESV)
